name: Deluge Heavyball
description: The thrower stands poised like a pair of perched hawks with a weight hanging from each fist.

name: Eclipse Cordthree
description: The thrower fixes on the target's lead knee and reads whether it is bearing weight or ready to move.

name: Peal Bolaweight
description: A flick of the free cord like a pinion feather snaps against the opponent's face and spoils his guard.

name: Thrall Joinknot
description: Both weights wrap one leg from above and below and qi pulls the cords into a hard double knot.

name: Prismstone
description: The cords spread wide from each hand like hawk wings and shield the thrower's whole front.

name: Springing Ballsling
description: A springing backward leap with the weights lifted overhead breaks away like a hawk rising off a branch.

name: Prismorb
description: Two weights dive at the target from opposite quarters and strike together on one line.

name: Retribution Tripcord
description: Cords are coiled low in a hidden ring that cinches shut about a foe's ankles when he steps inside.

name: Thunderclap Wrapup
description: Both weights are cast ahead and the thrower hauls across the gap in a blur to land behind the foe.

name: Peerless Thunderclap Stonehead
description: The school's closing stroke: two weights stoop from either side, pierce the guard and bind both legs as one.

name: Hobble Boon
description: The thrower stands in the formal court posture with the weights held low and the back straight.

name: Squallbola
description: The weights are drawn up and released in one slow measured motion along a straight line.

name: Undaunted Spindle
description: The cord is drawn across the forearm like a long sleeve and blocks a slash at the wrist.

name: Whirlcast Vow
description: A single qi-driven wrap rebukes a charge by locking both knees at the moment of the step.

name: Commanding Bindfall
description: The cord pins the opponent's weapon arm and holds it motionless until he stops struggling.

name: Skyborne Cordfork
description: Steps are taken at an even court pace that keeps the thrower exactly at the cast's range.

name: Peal Tripcord
description: A quick look at the opponent's stance tells the thrower which of his limbs will give first.

name: Inferno Ballsling
description: The weights circle outward in a summoning ring that drags every foe within it off balance.

name: Bolavow
description: A charged cord is laid at the court's threshold and trips whoever enters without leave.

name: Peremptory Shackle
description: Heavy qi runs down the cord at the sentence and presses the bound foe's strength to a crawl.

name: Destiny Fetter
description: The school's formal closing sequence of summons, bind, rebuke and strike delivered in a single unbroken motion.

name: Evanescent Whirlcast
description: The thrower holds both weights low at the hips like two cupped hands over a basin.

name: Peal Heavyball
description: Both weights skim the ground around the rim of the foe's footing before striking his ankles.

name: Tight Cordfork
description: Both hands catch a returning weight at once and stop it from swinging back.

name: Stonehead Covenant
description: The two cords circle the legs in opposite currents and meet in a knot qi hardens.

name: Subjugating Fetter
description: A tilting haul on both cords spills the foe off his feet like water from a basin.

name: Faithful Knotcenter
description: The paired weights meet a strike from both sides and pour its force away along the cords.

name: Magma Wrapup
description: The cords flood out across the ground in a spreading circle and tangle every foot they meet.

name: Parityorb
description: A set of low cords guides the foe's steps into a channel that closes on his feet.

name: Pulsar Spindle
description: The thrower snaps a weight to the far brim of the field and is drawn across in an instant.

name: Venerable Bindfall
description: The school's closing stroke: both cords overflow the field and bind every foe in reach as one.

name: Nimblefetter

name: Thunderclap Joinknot
description: Each hand casts into its own channel and the cords meet again at the target.

name: Thrall Bolaweight
description: The thrower braces like a river bank and lets the snared foe strain against the cord in vain.

name: Haemalbola
description: A swift rap of the weight flows past the opponent's guard to strike the ribs.

name: Imperious Wrapup
description: A qi-driven wrap ends the argument of the legs by locking them together at the shin.

name: Cordthree Odyssey
description: A step from one cord's line to the other's confuses the foe about which weight will fall.

name: Pealbola
description: A glance at the foe's shifting weight shows which way his body will be carried next.

name: Heavyball Reliquary
description: Both cords flow before the body in opposite streams and carry away several successive blows.

name: Bedrock Joinknot
description: The cords sweep wide on both sides and drop every foe standing between the two currents.

description: The thrower casts down each channel in turn, then draws both cords together at the foe's knees.

name: Millstone Shackle
description: Two streams of qi run down the cords and join, pressing the bound foe's strength to nothing.

name: Millstone Cordfork

name: Magmaorb

name: Wily Knotcenter
description: Cords staked along two crossing tracks form a lattice that snags any foe who runs through.

name: Interstice Stonehead

name: Ascendant Fetter
description: The school's closing hold: both tracks join about the foe and keep tightening until he yields.

name: Steelbola

name: Guileful Ballsling

name: Statute Joinknot
description: At the edict a Core-driven cast seizes the foe's limbs and holds his strength down.

name: Volition Tripcord
description: The school's highest sequence of salute, summons, snare and verdict, built over a few breaths and loosed at once.

name: Statute Shackle

name: Sigilorb

description: The cast runs straight down the bearing so the cords never drift off the line.

name: Pealstone

name: Season Fetter

description: The thrower reads the grass flattened by the wind to learn where the quarry fled.

name: Masterful Bindfall
description: The cord's tail snaps across a drawn blade and knocks it from its line.

name: Imperious Whirlcast

name: Orbpledge

name: Windborne Cordthree
description: The thrower keeps a loping plateau pace that never falters while the quarry is run down.

name: Silken Shackle

name: Masterful Thrall Whirlcast
description: The school's closing oath: the cords are sworn never to loosen until the foe's strength gives out.

name: Evanescent Bolaweight
description: The thrower stands with the toes at the very lip of the drop and the cords hanging inward.

name: Ballsling Crown

name: Interstice Knotcenter
description: The thrower feels the crumbling edge through the heels and chooses only the sound ground.

name: Thrallhobble
description: A cast hooks the ankle on the edge and a pull tips the foe toward the drop.

name: Warding Heavyball

name: Glidestone

name: Wily Joinknot
description: Charged cords are pegged along the cliff foot so any foot that crosses is pulled down.

name: Orbedict
description: The weights swing in a wide arc along the ledge and carry every foe on it toward the edge.

name: Season Cordfork

name: Tyrannous Millstone Wrapup
description: The school's closing snare: one cast takes the foe's feet and drops him on the very lip of the fall.

name: Deft Tripcord
description: Standing under the open sky, the thrower holds the cords low and the shoulders loose.

name: Squall Stonehead
description: The thrower swears the cast to the next gust and releases as it arrives.

name: Eclipse Spindle
description: The thrower reads the passing shadows of clouds on the ground to find hidden movement.

name: Cinching Hobble
description: A qi cast sworn to the wind curves round the foe and seats a firm wrap on his legs.

name: Ballsling Vow
description: The cords catch a gust and turn a spear thrust aside in one whipping arc.

name: Bedrock Hobble
description: The thrower runs the gust's line across open ground without breaking pace.

name: Interstice Cordthree
description: The thrower feels a gust's change on the skin and sets the aim a moment before it turns.

name: Magma Knotcenter
description: The cords whirl in a ring under the sky and drag every foe within reach to the ground.

name: Latchbola
description: A charged cord lies pegged along the gust's path and trips a runner who comes down it.

name: Radiance Cordfork
description: A weight anchored in a high gust draws the thrower forward in a single streak.

name: Ascendant Shackle
description: The school's closing oath-cast: a throw no gust can turn from its mark, binding the foe where he stands.

name: Stonevoyage

name: Stonegift
description: The thrower reckons the paces to the target by the bearing and sets the cast to them.

name: Inferno Joinknot
description: A long throw runs the whole bearing in one flowing motion and strikes the far mark.

name: Thrallorb
description: The thrower keeps the line taut along the bearing so the snared foe cannot cross it.

name: Unbending Bindfall
description: A Core-steadied cast wraps both legs along the bearing and holds them with perfect tension.

name: Stately Bolaweight
description: The thrower turns on the bearing to bring the cords across a blow and send it wide.

name: Hobbleodyssey

name: Serene Heavyball
description: The thrower holds the whole bearing in mind and senses every foe who nears the line.

name: Entropy Whirlcast
description: The weights sweep the full width of the bearing and throw down every foe upon it.

name: Tenet Stonehead
description: A long field of charged cords lies along the great bearing and snares whatever crosses it.

name: Twilit Heavyball
description: The thrower rides an anchored weight down the bearing and arrives at the far mark at once.

name: Ruling Hobble Covenant
description: The school's last and greatest capture: the cords hold the whole bearing and press down all within.
